subject: physics
question_text: State Newton’s first law of motion. What does it define?

verification.note: PREDICTED — Session 89 enumeration sweep (archetype × object grid over the NCERT chapter): this question has not appeared in any paper or source book we hold, but the chapter contains it and the 2-mark/4-mark format admits it. Authored as a lean card; promote to a full card when a paper season or a Telangana IPE teacher validates the cell. Split invented, as everywhere.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The statement
lines: Every body continues in its state of rest,
or of uniform motion in a straight line,
unless an external force acts on it.
steps.why: The law says what happens when NO force acts; that is why it is the law of inertia.
common_mistakes: Stating only the rest half and dropping "uniform motion in a straight line".

recall.must_convey: That a body stays at rest or in uniform motion in a straight line unless an external force acts.
accept: stays at rest or in uniform motion

steps.memory_tip: Three words carry it: rest, uniform, straight. Drop any one and the statement is incomplete.
steps.margin_note: First mark. The statement in full. The rest half alone is half a statement.

steps.label: What it defines
lines: Force is whatever changes a body’s state of
rest or of uniform motion. The law also
tells us that every body has inertia.
steps.why: The second law measures force once you already know what one is; the first law is what tells you what one IS.
common_mistakes: Answering "it defines momentum" or "it defines acceleration".

recall.must_convey: That the first law defines force, as whatever changes the state of rest or uniform motion.
reject: stays at rest or in uniform motion

steps.memory_tip: First law defines force, second law measures it, third law says forces come in pairs.
steps.margin_note: Second mark. One word — FORCE. Inertia is the extra line, not the answer.

insider_note: The statement is only one mark. The second is the answer to what it defines: force. That half is the one usually left out.
